findings.concrete_trigger: AP io._npz calls guard(uncompressed_array_bytes+headroom) before writing; runtime treats int as stage and checks current size only or returns early.
findings.fix: Recognize integer prospective bytes; check current+prospective against remaining output scope synchronously on every write guard. Retain final uncached full scope verification.
findings.issue: Byte headroom guard arguments are ignored and all checks throttle30s, including writes.

findings.concrete_trigger: A raw author argv or hung callable allocates beyond max_rss_bytes/max_output_bytes without calling the cooperative callback.
findings.fix: Parent must sample all owned processes/output scope and terminate its owned session on cap violations; enforce before completion.
findings.issue: No parent-enforced RSS/output watchdog; raw argv does not run ResourceCheck.

findings.concrete_trigger: Leader writes result and exits0 while a child continues, or TERM exits leader but leaves descendants. process.poll()/wait return without complete session drain.
findings.fix: Track genuine owned session identities and require all owned descendants/group members absent before completion; preserve failed wait/drain receipts.
findings.issue: Leader exit is treated as group completion; descendant absence is not checked.

findings.concrete_trigger: Two large jobs launch before either allocates, each sees the same MemAvailable and exceeds combined available memory.
findings.fix: Reserve unconsumed admitted maximum RSS against shared RAM headroom with explicit existing-job margin.
findings.issue: No aggregate reservation subtraction for newly admitted process memory.

findings.concrete_trigger: Other controllers consume a GPU after the snapshot; ARGGNN_MAX_CUDA_RESERVED_BYTES is an environment label rather than a runtime enforcement check.
findings.fix: Use shared locked GPU reservations and direct allocator/device checks in the worker/parent; retain UUID mapping.
findings.issue: No shared inter-controller GPU admission lock or enforced GPU allocation cap.

findings.concrete_trigger: AP fit calls io._new_output at final save. Passing outer task output would fail after completing training because scheduler already created it.
findings.fix: AP factory will bind its native output to outer/native; ROOT factory kwargs must use outer task scope.
findings.issue: Factories that require absent native output must not receive scheduler precreated outer output.

review_mode: complete source read and concrete control-flow review; no launch
